item.title: SCOTTISH CUP DRAW: CELTIC v St MIRREN
item.description: CELTIC will play St Mirren in the Scottish Cup semi-final at Hampden next month. Martin O’Neill’s battlers won through to the last four after a tension-laden 4-2 penalty-kick shoot-out triumph over Danny Rohl’s side following a scoreless extra-time stalemate at Ibrox this afternoon. item.title: ‘OUT ON THEIR FEET,’ MARTIN HAILS NON-STOP CELTS
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL, at the age of 74 years and one week, looked almost as shattered as his players after Celtic’s 4-2 Scottish Cup penalty-kick shoot-out triumph at Ibrox. item.title: ‘TWISTS AND TURNS,’ O’NEILL COUNTDOWN BEGINS
item.description: THE countdown to the conclusion of Martin O’Neill’s interim period in charge of Celtic is underway. The Irishman will have to address nine Premiership games and, hopefully, two Scottish Cup-ties before he says a final farewell after his dramatic return on two occasions during the champions’ turbulent season.
